messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: CatalogService alert `model-config-invalid-default` (severity: high). Affected: model-catalog promotion pipeline. Trigger: validation failure — tokenizer mismatch detected during warmup. PD incident: INC-8023.

pagerduty: Auto-assigned to jess_oncall. Please acknowledge.

jess_oncall: acked :white_check_mark: I'm on it. Can someone share the immediate customer impact?

rita_sre: see logs from the catalog promotion job — tokenizer field in the new revision is `tokenizer: "byte"` but our defaults expect `bpe`. Runtime throws decode errors, leading to garbled outputs and some 500s.

sam_ml: confirming — the latest promoted revision is `rev-2026-03-10a` (promotion job #789). It overwrote the `tokenizer` metadata on a handful of variants. Probably a bad merge from a model-card update.

jess_oncall: do we have an easy rollback? Can we pin traffic to previous revision until we fix metadata?

rita_sre: yes — we can pin routing at the catalog layer for affected model family. Quick mitigation: set policy to route to `rev-2026-03-09z` and disable promotions. Example (admin API):

```
POST https://internal-catalog.redwood/v1/models/model-x/routes
{
  "route": "pinned",
  "revision": "rev-2026-03-09z",
  "timeout": 30
}
```

jess_oncall: doing the pin now. Running the admin call.

jess_oncall: POST returned 202, job started. incident-bot: please watch job ID 10234 and notify on completion.

incident-bot: Job 10234 started. Will post status updates.

kate_prod: customers flagged: acct-881, acct-1122, and a small trial customer in EU. Reports: garbled tokens mid-response, some 502/500 errors on chat endpoints. CS has opened P0 tickets; I'm pinging them.

sam_ml: while we pin, we should also remove the bad field from the catalog entry in the repo and push a corrected promotion. I can prepare a hotfix to set `tokenizer: "bpe"` and re-run validation.

rita_sre: also recommend scaling up the fallback pool briefly — we saw retry storms. I'll bump capacity for the fallback cluster.

jess_oncall: Job 10234 finished — routes now pinned to rev-2026-03-09z. Initial smoke tests show decoded outputs look normal. Latency returning to baseline for sampled requests.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-8023: acknowledged by jess_oncall; status: investigating.

sam_ml: hotfix prepared. Diff is just the tokenizer field in the model metadata: `- "tokenizer": "byte"` -> `+ "tokenizer": "bpe"`. Will run validation and promote after QA.

jess_oncall: please run smoke tests against a canary of the fixed promotion (10% traffic) before full rollout. Keep pin in place until validation complete.

sam_ml: starting canary promotion now (canary=10%). Posting logs: validation passed locally. Promotion job #790 kicked off.

incident-bot: Promotion job #790 completed: validation OK. Canary 10% applied. Monitoring for errors for 15m.

kate_prod: CS updated — two customers report successful behavior after the pin. One still had transient errors but accepted workaround. Will keep them informed.

rita_sre: I scaled fallback cluster +25% and verified no retry amplification. No errors observed on pinned routes in last 5m.

jess_oncall: good. I'll leave the page open for another 30m for observation then handoff to @rita_sre for postmortem follow-up and full rollout when TOC approves. Anyone want to escalate to eng-runtime or keep within SRE/ML?

sam_ml: no need to escalate further; ML team will coordinate the promotion. We'll add a unit test in the promotion pipeline to assert tokenizer is in approved list.

jess_oncall: Handoff: I'm off shift in 35m. @rita_sre will take severity watch. Please add timeline to INC-8023 and include: root cause (bad promotion metadata), mitigation (pin to previous revision + hotfix), customer impact (3 customers with garbled outputs/5xx), next steps (pipeline validation, new unit test, postmortem).

rita_sre: acknowledged. I'll own the incident loop and schedule postmortem. Please attach the promotion diffs and job IDs in the ticket.

pagerduty: Incident INC-8023 updated: status -> monitoring. Assigned -> rita_sre.

jess_oncall: closing my active tasks. Thanks everyone. :heart:

sam_ml: after postmortem we'll push the validation test and revert auto-promotion until we have the guardrails.

rita_sre: noted. I'll coordinate the blameless postmortem and check if quota/auto-scale thresholds should be tuned to avoid retry storms next time.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8023 status: monitoring -> resolved (pending postmortem) in 45m if no regressions.

jess_oncall: resolved for my shift; handing off to rita_sre.
